app.name: AggregatorIQ
app.tagline: Find the money your aggregators kept.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.recoveryIdentifiedHint: Across every reconciliation run in this period.
dashboard.recoveredToDateHint: Amounts aggregators have actually paid back.
dashboard.effectiveCommissionHint: What they really took, not the contracted rate.
dashboard.noBranches: Add a branch to get started.
dashboard.noRuns: No reconciliation has run yet. Upload a statement and an order export, then run one.
dashboard.northStar: Recovery per branch, as a multiple of subscription
dashboard.northStarHealthy: Above five times — the economics work.
dashboard.northStarWatch: Below three times — churn usually follows within four months.

statements.title: Statements
statements.subtitle: What we have, what we are missing, and how each file was read.
statements.uploadHint: CSV or XLSX export from the aggregator's partner portal.
statements.forwardHere: Or forward the statement email to
statements.forwardHint: Forward the aggregator's settlement email as it arrives and it lands here parsed.
statements.coverageGapsHint: Periods with orders but no statement. Nothing in these ranges has been reconciled.
statements.noGaps: No gaps — every period with orders has a statement.

recon.title: Reconciliation
recon.unmatchedHint: Statement lines we could not attribute to an order. They are not in any finding — a guess here would be a claim about an order that was never involved.
recon.sourceRowsHint: The exact rows of the exact file. Every figure above comes from these.
recon.notClaimable: Not counted in the claimable total
recon.notClaimableHint: Real, and worth knowing, but not money anyone is going to pay back.
recon.noFindings: No discrepancies above the materiality threshold. That is a good result, not an empty screen.

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.subtitle: Turn findings into a claim you can actually submit.
disputes.empty: No disputes yet. Select findings on a reconciliation run to build a pack.

margin.title: Margin
margin.subtitle: What each channel actually costs after everything the aggregator took.
margin.gapHint: The difference between the rate in your contract and the rate you actually paid.

settings.title: Settings
settings.timezoneHint: Decides which statement period an order falls in. Worth getting right.
settings.commissionRateHint: As a percentage. This is what the engine judges every charge against.
settings.effectiveHint: Rates change. Old periods keep their old rate so past reconciliations still reproduce.
settings.materialityHint: Differences below this are ignored. Noise costs more trust than it finds money.

audit.title: See what your aggregator kept
audit.subtitle: Drop in one settlement statement. We will tell you what looks wrong, in about a minute, without an account.

stages.checking: Checking every charge against standard terms

audit.resultNothing: We could not find anything clearly wrong in this statement.
audit.resultNothingHint: That is worth knowing too. A statement with no discrepancies is a well-run account — or a period where the errors are in a file we have not seen.
audit.blurredHint: Create an account to see which orders, and the statement rows behind each finding.
audit.signUp: Create an account to see the detail
audit.assumptionsHint: You have not told us your contracted rates, so this uses each aggregator's standard published terms. With your real contract the number is usually higher.
audit.noAccountNeeded: No account, no card, no call.

errors.noOrganisation: You are signed in but not part of an organisation yet.
errors.insufficientRole: You do not have permission to do that.
